name: ModelVariant825_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant825_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (between the start and end times a new bolt leaves a model point every period, up to the row's bolt count, and flies towards a jittered point on the opposing slot, wrapped in a ring of sprites and spinning Gouraud strips and trailing a ribbon and smoke puffs; on arrival each bolt flares into a glow with two fans of rays, a burst of animated sparks and a growing spray of animated Gouraud streaks while the ambient light dims and recovers); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, seeds the bolt rings, puffs, rays, streaks and sparks and packs six textures from five images, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 before the start time, 4 on each frame after the first bolt arrives, 1 once when the end time has passed and the last bolt has arrived, 2 once the last glow has faded after the light recovers and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-842 and 939 images build it from the same source. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
